summary: Counts backend listen() calls with a fake listen: 1 and 10 panes reading terminal output, terminal exit, pane-agent and workspace-land make exactly one backend listen per event kind (not one per pane), and the last pane leaving makes exactly one unlisten.

tests.name: LAG-09 shared listeners > ten panes reading output and exits make one backend listen per event kind, not one per pane
LAG-09 shared listeners > ten panes reading pane-agent and workspace-land through listenShared make one backend listen each
LAG-09 shared listeners > the last pane leaving removes the shared listener, not before, and a pane mounting later listens again
